t_advice_summary_textbox.text: there are specific colours which will score higher than other colours

vb_textbox.text: In my opinion, the colour of the gnomes or baskets mean nothing. My strategy was that the 1x multi was for the left side gnomes, and the right for the 5x multi, this swapped through each quarter of the game. I also think that when presented with a 0, no matter what gnome you had picked it would have still given you 0 points.
